answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The vertex is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst.
